Near Home.summary: The Heath Info Hut Pop by the Heath Info Hut at Parliament Hill for information about Hampstead Heath and what’s coming up. Click here for the location. You can: pick up a free map or nature sheet find out about upcoming events and activities ask questions of our friendly team buy Hampstead Heath-related goodies (e.g. books, cards, bags)

Near Home.title: Litter pick
Near Home.summary: Join us for a Saturday afternoon litter pick. All welcome and all equipment provided. Meet at 12pm at the Heath Info Hut (the former Tennis Bookings Hut), Hampstead Heath, near the Parliament Hill tennis courts - no need to book, although you can let us know that you’re planning to come along so that we know roughly how many to expect.

Expect the Gothic thrills of 'La Belle Dame Sans Merci', the ghostly visions of 'Isabella, or The Pot of Basil' and a summoning of the witches and elves which lurk in the corners of his poem
